findings.title: Committed prompt/audit corpus bloats the repo and review surface
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: prompts/ is 625 tracked files / 9.42 MB (manifest pins 623 files) and scripts/verify-prompts.js:29-31 enforces a documented 640-file / 10 MiB budget (verify fails past it, :121-138) while now excluding .pyc/__pycache__ (:50-53); docs/audits adds 115 files / 3.98 MB. Externalization remains an owner decision (docs still describe the corpus as pinned historical data), and the audit corpus itself has no budget - raised as new HYGIENE-P3-014.

findings.title: docs/audits corpus grows unbounded with no size or retention policy (prompts/ is budget-guarded, audits are not)
findings.note: NEW at 7dd0402. docs/audits grew from 75 files / 2,729,701 bytes at 8d299b8 to 115 files / 3,977,539 bytes now (+46% in 3 days) as each re-audit commits a full corpus copy; prompts/ has an enforced budget (scripts/verify-prompts.js:29-31, 640 files / 10 MiB) but docs/audits has none - docs/audits/README.md:13-70 defines the layout and the never-overwrite rule without bounding the corpus, and no gate notices the growth. Impact: clone/index/review surface grows with every run. Recommendation: define a retention or budget policy (keep the last N runs, move older runs to an archive branch/artifact, or add a documented size check).

findings.title: scripts/README.md lists sync-product-catalog.mjs twice
